name: Google search landscape for legal searches: directories, videos, People Also Ask and how concentrated the top 10 is
description: What a person sees when they search Google for a lawyer or legal help in the United States: how often lawyer directories (FindLaw, Justia, Avvo, Super Lawyers and others), videos and the People Also Ask box appear, how many of the top-10 results are directories, and how concentrated the results are in a few websites, by practice area, search type (cost, near me, best, versus, how-to) and language (English, Spanish). Built from 2,240 legal searches (22,089 top-10 results) saved from Google on 2026-10-29 and 30; every group has at least 30 searches and no firm or person is named.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Google search landscape for legal searches: directories, videos, People Also Ask and how concentrated the top 10 is (Version 1.1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964129

distribution.name: serp-landscape.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: serp-landscape.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: serp-landscape
recordSet.description: The records of Google search landscape for legal searches: directories, videos, People Also Ask and how concentrated the top 10 is, one per CSV row.

field.name: group
field.description: The group key: group type, segment and language, then the measure

field.name: groupType
field.description: The measure (column key of the long-format CSV)

field.name: segmentType
field.description: all, language, practice, query-type, practice-by-language, query-type-by-language, publisher, metro-size, metro or position

field.name: segment
field.description: The practice, search type, language or website the row is about

field.name: value
field.description: The measure (a share in percent rounded to one decimal, an average, or a count of websites)

field.name: queries
field.description: Legal searches in the group (N); every group has at least 30

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the saved results were last checked

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
